messages:
Maya Wilson: Hey team — partner (NimbusGrid) sent over final marketing assets for the joint solution brief and marketplace tile. Quick review please? Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/nimbus-redwood-brief :eyes:
Ethan Cole: Opening now. Are we using the horizontal logo or stacked lockup in the hero? Nimbus included both svgs.
Maya Wilson: They recommend horizontal for marketplace thumbnail, stacked for one-pager hero. Want to confirm accessibility alt text and badge placement.
Priya Nair: Quick legal check: can we use the customer quote on the one-pager? They marked it "approved" but no attribution line included. Need company name + title or a signed release.
Jordan Park: From Nimbus — we have a signed quote PDF, I'll pull the attribution. Use: "NimbusGrid — Sarah Lee, VP Prod". Also FYI their brand guide: https://nimbus.example/brand-guidelines (colors & clearspace).
Liam Chen: Thx Jordan. For the marketplace tile, can we tighten the clearspace on the Redwood lockup? Current mock feels cramped.
Ethan Cole: Agree. Also the partner provided a compressed PNG for the thumbnail — can we swap for the SVG to avoid jaggies?
Maya Wilson: Yes, prefer SVG. Ethan, can you export a 1x and 2x PNG fallback for marketplace?
Ethan Cole: Yep. Will export 512x512 and 1024x1024 PNGs from the SVG.
Priya Nair: On the quote: Jordan, once you attach the signed PDF, I can confirm we have release for usage across web/social. Also check trademark line — they have an ™ on their product name.
Jordan Park: Uploaded signed_quote_nimbus.pdf to the figma file — bottom-right assets pane. Trademark confirmed (they gave explicit permission).
Liam Chen: Copy for the brief — we trimmed the lead paragraph to fit the hero. Leaving the technical benefit bullets intact. Anyone see a problem with the messaging?
Ethan Cole: Looks good, only ask is headline contrast on the hero image — #ffffff on their gradient alpha is borderline. I'll try #f6f8ff or add a 16% black overlay.
Maya Wilson: Nice. Can you attach quick screenshots of both overlay options by EOD? I'll run a quick A/B in the marketplace QA.
Ethan Cole: Will do.
Priya Nair: One more: alt text examples for accessibility. Proposal:
- marketplace tile: "NimbusGrid + Redwood Inference joint solution thumbnail, purple gradient background, product lockups"
- hero image: "Engineer using Redwood Inference with NimbusGrid integration, dashboard visible"
Ethan Cole: Those alt texts are fine. I'll add them to the image assets metadata.
Jordan Park: Small ask from Nimbus marketing — can we include a co-branded badge that reads "Powered by NimbusGrid & Redwood" on the case study cover? They attached a badge SVG.
Maya Wilson: Fine as long as it sits beneath the headline and respects both clearspace rules. Priya — any legal concerns?
Priya Nair: Fine. Ensure badge does not imply endorsement beyond the integration. We'll approve the final layout.
Liam Chen: Great — timeline? We want marketplace publish by next Tuesday. Any blockers?
Maya Wilson: Blockers: Ethan deliver overlays + PNGs, Jordan confirm signed quote (done), Priya final legal signoff once quote is attached.
Ethan Cole: PNGs + two overlay variants posted to figma by 1714600200.
Priya Nair: I'll do final signoff once I see the attached signed PDF and the badge placement — aim to sign off by 1714600300.
Maya Wilson: Perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan Park: Thanks — Nimbus excited to launch with you. :rocket:
